* Timestamps <2026-10-05 Mon> in a headline
Active <2026-10-01 Thu>, inactive [2026-10-01 Thu], bare <2026-10-01> and [2026-10-01].
With times <2026-10-01 Thu 10:00>, <2026-10-01 Thu 10:00-11:30> and [2026-10-01 Thu 10:00].
Repeaters <2026-10-01 Thu +1w>, <2026-10-01 Thu .+2d -3d>, <2026-10-01 Thu ++1m/3m>.
Ranges <2026-10-01 Thu>--<2026-10-03 Sat>, [2026-10-01 Thu]--[2026-10-03 Sat].
One dash <2026-10-01 Thu>-<2026-10-03 Sat>, three <2026-10-01 Thu>---<2026-10-03 Sat>.
Four dashes <2026-10-01 Thu>----<2026-10-03 Sat> and mixed <2026-10-01 Thu>--[2026-10-03 Sat].
Mismatched brackets <2026-10-01 Thu] and [2026-10-01 Thu>.
No space <2026-10-01Thu> and <2026-10-01  Thu> with two spaces.
Unclosed <2026-10-01 Thu and a later > closes it.
Unclosed [2026-10-01 Thu with nothing after
Short year <226-10-01 Thu>, short month <2026-1-01 Thu>, letters <2026-ab-01>.
Inside words x<2026-10-01 Thu>y and (<2026-10-01 Thu>).
In markup =<2026-10-01 Thu>=, ~[2026-10-01 Thu]~, *<2026-10-01 Thu>* and /x [2026-10-01 Thu] y/.
In a link [[https://example.com][x <2026-10-01 Thu>]] and <2026-10-01 Thu>[[x]].
Two on a line <2026-10-01 Thu><2026-10-02 Fri> and [2026-10-01 Thu][2026-10-02 Fri].
Range then text <2026-10-01 Thu>--<2026-10-03 Sat>-- and <2026-10-01 Thu>--x.

* Planning
